correctness.rationale: The functional equation expands to \(L+L^3)x+(I+L^2)c=0\), forcing \(L^2=I\) for invertible \(L\). With \(D=I+L\) square-zero and \(v=Dc\), direct carrier increments give \(\delta_j=Dx_j+Db_0+(j-1)v+c\) and \(\delta_j^{\prime}=\delta_j+(N+1)v\). Thus \(T^2\) has the stated parity-dependent translation and \(T^4=I\). Its fixed states are independent kernel fibers exactly when \(c\) lies in \(\operatorname{im}D\), and the orbit census follows. Image/kernel flags enumerate each rank of \(D\). Actual verify.py was executed, including 846906 exact finite assertions, while unrestricted positive dimensions and lattice lengths follow from the proof.

value.rationale: This resolves all orbit lengths and multiplicities for a canonical nontrivial subclass of a recent finite-field integrable cellular automaton, without dimension/length restrictions. It gives a sharp structural characterization of universal period four and shows why periods larger than four, if present in the full class, must arise from genuinely nonlinear rules; the result is an exact natural dynamical classification, not an arbitrary small enumeration.
